item.title: Missouri State researcher creates new Missouri wine with surprising characteristics
item.description: (This article comes courtesy of MissouriNet.) A Missouri State University researcher has created a new offspring of Missouri’s famous Norton Grape. And instead of being the rich purple of the Norton- this grape is white, adding another version of a wine that is already distinctive. item.title: Mountain Grove Man Sentenced to 7 Years for January Domestic Incident
item.description: 30-year-old Cody Schilling of Mountain Grove entered an Alford Plea in Court Wednesday for charges stemming from a January incident.
